description: PK — mã lượt vụ×đối tượng, unique per dòng (per-row unique, PK nguồn VARCHAR2 UUID). ETL hàng ngày lọc theo Decision_Date của Examination Team (xem dòng Examination Team Code)

(Sửa 2026-08-11) Mã vụ việc — mã đoàn kiểm tra. Đổi nguồn từ Examination Team Target.Examination Team Code (lookup pair denormalized) sang join thẳng Examination Team.Examination Team Code, khớp SQL BA (alias a = EXAMINATION_TEAM, a.CODE)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' AND examination_team.decision_dt = :etl_date → examination_team.examination_team_code

description: Tên đối tượng được kiểm tra
Phân loại đối tượng — map 1:1 từ nguồn, không qua Classification Value
Loại hình — scheme TT_REVIEW_FORM_TYPE (PERIODIC/UNSCHEDULED → Định kỳ/Đột xuất)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' AND examination_team.decision_dt = :etl_date → examination_team.form_tp_code

description: Trạng thái — ETL-derived từ Examination Team.Start_Date/End_Date: cả 2 NULL→Chưa thực hiện; Start NOT NULL AND End NULL→Đang thực hiện; cả 2 NOT NULL→Đã hoàn thành
etl_logic: INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' AND examination_team.decision_dt = :etl_date → CASE WHEN examination_team.start_dt IS NULL AND examination_team.end_dt IS NULL THEN 'NOT_STARTED' WHEN examination_team.start_dt IS NOT NULL AND examination_team.end_dt IS NULL THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN examination_team.start_dt IS NOT NULL AND examination_team.end_dt IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED' END

description: Ngày ban hành quyết định kiểm tra — date key
etl_logic: INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' AND examination_team.decision_dt = :etl_date → examination_team.decision_dt

description: Năm ban hành quyết định — slicer Year=selected_year
etl_logic: INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' AND examination_team.decision_dt = :etl_date → YEAR(examination_team.decision_dt)
